integrity: The analytic proof concerns a marked conditional weak limit and credits existing scalar-probability results. Finite calculations are reproducibility diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: The marked limit is proved for three independent interior-uniform points in collapsing rectangles, not arbitrary convex bodies or boundary-sampled points.
The classical all-aspect-ratio scalar rectangle obtusity probability was already derived by Langford (1969) and is not claimed as new.
No uniform finite-height error rate is asserted; a plausible 1969 specialist full text and its 1970 extension could not be read.
title: A marked logarithmic scaling law for acute triangles in collapsing rectangles
